text: Fuhito Transformed is the second form of Fuhito fought at the end of Chapter 23 in Before Crisis -Final Fantasy VII-.
Bone armor was a type of natural light armor found in use on the Malatran Plateau and the desert world of Athas where metal was a scarce resource.

Galdes is the main antagonist in Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Ring of Fates, Hierophant of the Crystal Temple at Rebena Te Ra. In reality, Galdes is the Lunite King, plotting to harness the power of the Great Crystal through Starsingers like Chelinka and Princess Tilika to recreate the world in his own image.

G Commando is an enemy from Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII-. He is a copy of Genesis and attacks with two curved blades. Stop Blade is useful. G Commando immediately counters magic attacks with Thundara.

G Smasher is an enemy in Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII-. He is a copy of Genesis Rhapsodos and closely resembles him. G Smasher is essentially the G Eraser minus the Scorcher attack, meaning the player can fight him in the same method. Continuous attacks or Gravity or Assault Twister work well with timed rolls or guards to prevent or mitigate damage.

Bodyfeeder was a psionic weapon quality that could be added to weapons. It enabled a wielder to teleport themselves and their equipment to another location within a short distance. Weapons imbued with this quality gave off a strong psionic aura of psychometabolism.

The Giant Crab is an enemy in the Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles series. It dwells in the waterfall of the River Belle Path. It is a crab (or crab-like monster) that is significantly larger than normal crabs. It is a beast with scars and wounds from past battles, as well as several weapons sticking out from its carapace.

The Ice Gigas is a monster from Final Fantasy II. It serves as one of the bosses in the Tower of Mysidia, guarding the spell Ultima. Firion and his allies must defeat it on their way up the tower. He later appears as a random encounter in Pandaemonium's secret room.
The Ice Drake is a Water-elemental enemy in Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Ranged Yarhi.

The Bloody Keel was the ship of the fiery red haired rogue Sheila Kree. It received its name from the punishment its captain exacted upon those who did not obey, [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keelhauling keelhauling]. Catti-brie sank the Bloody Keel by shooting the helmsman as Sheila Kree and her band was making a hasty escape from her cove. With no one at the helm, the Bloody Keel crashed against the rocks and sank.

Ifrit-Egi is a pet in Final Fantasy XIV. It is called by the ability. Egis are arcane constructs created using the lingering aetheric essence of a defeated primal, in this case the Lord of the Inferno, Ifrit.
Jeume is a character in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Impassive Prodigy, she is a secondary protagonist of Another Story and is the crystal warrior of wind.

Kamineko is an enemy from Final Fantasy IV: The After Years. He is fought alongside Mad Vegan and initially with Naoki Mutou, though Naoki will be replaced by the Tako Luka, Cactaor, and Cynico. He cannot be damaged, and there is no reward for defeating him.

Blue Lightning was an enchanted bow belonging to the ogre mage Sothillis, ruler of the Sothillisian Empire in Amn in the late 14 century DR. It was a +1 distance thundering, shocking burst composite longbow.

Khimaira is both the name of a Notorious Monster and the family of monsters to which it belongs in Final Fantasy XI. The Khimaira is an arcana found on Hediva Isle in Caedarva Mire. The origins of this creature is unknown but it is rumored to be a byproduct of a secret Imperial bioweapon engineering program. Being a monster that has parts of different creatures on it, the Khimaira has a wide variety of attacks that it uses when engaged in battle. Its most devastating attack is Fulmination, which is an extremely powerful thunder-based area attack. The title awarded for defeating Khimaira is Khimaira Carver. Variants of the Khimaira were once only found in Aht Urhgan territories, but the monster has since appeared in the Walk of Echoes and most recently in Abyssea as well.

Kyrra is a bangaa Dragoon from Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift. He requests Clan Gully's help when he is about to be beaten by another clan. When Clan Gully and Kyrra are victorious, he later teaches the clan the arts of the Dragoon as a token of appreciation.
Lightning is the sole directly-controllable player character in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII. She utters various lines during battle, depending on actions taken.
The Bow of the Black Archer was the weapon of the elven deity Shevarash until he was captured and slain by the drow.

Lightwardens , also known as Wardens, are powerful creatures of primordial Light introduced in Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers. Lightwardens take command of the sin eaters in a surrounding region. Though the sin eaters are motivated by only the basest of instincts, such as hunger, even they answer to a hierarchy, and follow the most powerful among them, thus giving rise to what the locals of the First dubbed Lightwardens. Lightwardens serve as the primary adversaries and major bosses that the Warrior of Light (rebranded as the Warrior of Darkness) must face in the Shadowbringers expansion.

Madoushi, also known by his real name Akai Kiri, is a character in Final Fantasy: Unlimited. The older brother of Makenshi, he looks similar except for his red clothes and hair. Like Makenshi, he wears a veil over his face because he breathes out Mist. Madoushi is voiced by Hideyuki Tanaka in the Japanese version and David Stokey in the English version.

Mateus is the totema of the humes in Final Fantasy Tactics Advance, and is the fifth and final Totema fought by Marche Radiuju. After being defeated, Mateus can be summoned by any hume member of Clan Nutsy. Two Dephs of Mateus also appear during the fight with Remedi in her Li-Grim form. Unlike the other appearances of Mateus, the totema is an armored female warrior, not an armor with a goddess as a living shield. As Mateus is the totema of the Hume race, she possesses two abilities usable by humes: the Illusionist ability Star Cross, and the Black Mage spell Thundaga.

Braeder was a gnome and a local hero of the village of Ieirithymbul in the Sword Mountains. Braeder was the namesake of Braeder's Pit, a sinkhole that swallowed up the Felrenden stream in the western edge of the Sword Mountains near Ieirithymbul, by the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Meriluke is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. She is a member of Glaciela Wezette's Spirare and is known as the Lightning Fast Striker.
The Red Wyrm is a Fire-elemental enemy from Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Ranged Yarhi.
The Rudra , also known as the Roc or Rukh, is a recurring creature in the Final Fantasy series, first appearing in Final Fantasy IV.

Borlin, blood of Ghellin, titled Axe of the Iron House, was a dwarf of the Iron House, the exiled royal court of the Mines of Tethyamar. He was a descendant of Ghellin, King-in-Exile of the Iron House. He was also a leader of dwarven armies, such as the Mithril Legion.
SAM08G is an enemy in Final Fantasy VIII. It is a Galbadian cybernetic weapon.

Volg is a non-player character in three titles of the Chocobo series. He is an exceptionally strong chocobo—he claims to be one of the mightiest chocobos to have ever walked the earth—that is different from the rest of the Jailbirds Irma raises. In both of his first appearances, Volg's story is explained to have begun after his mother died protecting him from a beast. Since then, Volg trained to become stronger and had a unbeatable streak until he was injured in a fight with the monster that killed his mother, receiving the trademark scars across his beak and losing the use of his right eye. Irma, who watched the fight, saved him and she and her mother nurse him back to health. Giving him his name with the promise of a decent challenge from her own intent to become a treasure thief, Volg swears absolute loyalty to Irma, whom he refers to as his master.

Whisper Croceo is a boss in Final Fantasy VII Remake, fought at the end of Chapter 18, "Destiny's Crossroads". It is summoned to battle by the Whisper Harbinger. It absorbs and appears alongside its counterparts of other elemental alignments: Whisper Viridi and Whisper Rubrum. Together the trio morph into Whisper Bahamut. According to the Final Fantasy VII Remake Ultimania, Whisper Croceo takes his fighting style from Yazoo, a Remnant of Sephiroth from Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children. In the Japanese version, Whisper Croceo's Amber Whirl ability is named Velvet Nightmare, after Yazoo's gun.

Bredisker was a thief of the 12th century DR. In the Year of the Majesty, 1177 DR, in the southern Sword Coast lands, Bredisker successfully stole the Tome of Torment, the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God. Bredisker fled east to the Thornwood, but was continually harassed and stalked by the Ilmatari. A weary Bredisker soon sold the book to Lalaskra of Ormpetarr, a priestess of Loviatar and an enemy of the church.

Yiazmat is the ultimate Elite Mark in Final Fantasy XII. It is not only the ultimate mark, but also the ultimate boss. Defeating Yiazmat takes at least an hour at high levels and player skill, but usually takes longer. Yiazmat has well over 50 million hit points. This astronomically high number is the main reason why it takes so long to kill, since regular attacks break the damage limit only in the Zodiac versions. The player can accept the hunt for Yiazmat after vanquishing the optional boss Hell Wyrm and completing all Rank VII Marks. In the Zodiac versions, Yiazmat is also fought at Trial Mode on Stage 98 (with much less HP at 3.7M). Yagyu Darkblade (uncommon) and Mesa (rare) can be stolen from it.
The Yellow Wyrm is an Lightning-elemental enemy from Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Yarhi.
Helen Parr, also known as Elastigirl and Mrs. Incredible, is one of the main characters in The Incredibles and Incredibles 2.
Branson Marlek was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Hanuman is a large green character who appeared in Sanjay's Super Team. He also uses his tail to block Ravana's weapons.
Gale is a supporting character in in the Pixar film, Elemental. She is described as a stormy cloud and Wade's boss.
Mator is a young Unidentified Flying Object who befriends Mater in the Cars Toons episode, Unidentified Flying Mater.
Borlann was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1450 DR.

The Omnidroid 10 (also called the Omnidroid v.10 or the Omnidroid 10000) is a robot in the movie The Incredibles that was deployed by the villain Syndrome to attack the city of Metroville so he may destroy it himself, and gain fame and glory for its defeat and perhaps prove himself to Mr. Incredible. It was the last model of the Omnidroids created, and much larger, smarter and more powerful than the previous prototypes. It was perfected for the final stage of Operation Kronos.

, Class Name , is the "True" Archer-class Servant of Bazdilot Cordelion in the True and Fake Holy Grail Wars of Fate/strange Fake. As the result of his Master blackening Archer Heracles through the influence of Holy Grail Mud, Alcides is also of the Avenger-class.

is the Noble Phantasm of Ishtar in her swimsuit. As Maanna has become a present-day vehicle, the True Name has similarly been converted to a present-day format. She's set to enjoy summer to the fullest with all that she can muster. This iridian Noble Phantasm allows Ishtar to raise her spirits by going sightseeing at resorts all over the world on her Maanna Scooter, converting those happy feelings into magical energy, and letting it rain down on the earth. Her seasonal outfit being easy on the eye, the magical energy pouring down on the earth turns into glittering stars that damage enemies. Ishtar herself feels all happy and fabulous, but it really is a great nuisance to the earth below.

Breachgnomes were a type of gnomish fighter that were trained to single-handedly hold off enemies for as long as possible. Most breachgnomes were fighters, rangers, paladins, or barbarians. They were generally found only in gnomish villages, although occasionally they could be found traveling alone.
The Anaconda (アナコンダ, Anakonda) is a giant beast that fights Alexander Gallen during the Maximum Tournament Saga.
Asclepius was a god in the Kobol pantheon. He represented medicine, and people believed that praying to him could end their pain.
Chronos was a Lord of Kobol who, in mythology, slaughtered his father Uranus.
Bracers of armor were magical armor pieces for the forearms that protected the wearer with an invisible field of force that acted as a source of armor for his or her whole body.

John Cavil was a human who lived on Kobol over 4,000 years before the Fall of the Twelve Colonies. While originally a human, Cavil would later become a Humanoid Cylon, after he risked his life to help people out of a burning wreckage, during which time Kobol had fallen into chaos. Cavil, who was gravely wounded in his rescue attempts, while trying to help the survivors from the explosion of the Thirteenth Tribe's first resurrection facility, is downloaded into a new body as a reward for his heroism and selfless acts. He is assisted through the resurrection process by a fellow Cylon named Ellen, whom he reveals his name unto her. Cavil would later join the Thirteenth Tribe as the tribe left Kobol and set out to search for a new planet to live on: Earth. Cavil often came at odds with Michael Tigh regarding many issues, and the two developed a rivalry and resentment towards one another lasting years. Cavil also begins to embrace his new Cylon physiology and culture, and begins to resent the Kobollian humans and their nature, believing the humans to be flawed and destructive, where the humans would eventually destroy themselves. He begins to embrace his new life as a machine and resents his previous life as a human, becoming anti-human. Cavil also starts up a friendship with Ellen, with an indication that he may hold romantic feelings for her; whether Ellen reciprocated Cavil's feelings for her or had any knowledge of them is unknown. Nogow is the rather pig-headed leader of the Boar-like Borays on Sectar, consistently attacking the Human-run town of Serenity. He leads attacks when the moon is full on Sectar, which appears to be several times during a sectar. Sire Bogon and his townspeople decide to place all the food where it can be easily taken, and of course Nogow's Borays do a pretty good job of knocking-off constable after constable, as well as allowing for other Borays to take the human female of their choice. When comes along, the Borays under Nogow's command are driven back, however Nogow manages to take Siress Belloby. Starbuck manages to strike a deal with Nogow where he would be constable of the town and could have all the food and drink he desires. Apparently, he is also quite fond of Belloby, and both are apparently attracted to one another since Nogow is quite the "animal"—according to Belloby . de: Nogow

Vulpa is a Cylon Command Centurion commanding the Ravashol pulsar, a large energy-based weapon on the ice planet Arcta which becomes a lethal danger to the Fleet. Detecting the rag-tag fugitive fleet, Vulpa tasks his pilots with the abduction of a Colonial Warrior from . Forcing the cadet to crash land on the surface of Arcta, these pilots manage to return with Cadet Cree, whom he interrogates. As he suspects that Cree has provided misinformation during his interrogation, Vulpa subjects him to a brain probe, and has Cree thrown into a cold cell . During the assault on the pulsar and the Cylons' garrison, Vulpa enters the pulsar firing station and kills Leda. After this act, Vulpa is subsequently destroyed by Starbuck .

Boris Elberwelter was a human fighter and the proprietor of the Sign of Thunder inn of Thunderstone in the late 1360s DR. He was aided in its operatation by his wife Tasha Elberwelter. In the , he overheard the Wolfmasters adventuring company discussing fresh rumors of a great ruin in the Vast Swamp.
is a fight taking place during the Zanpakutō Rebellion. It focuses upon the conflict between 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa and his Zanpakutō Spirit, Ruri'iro Kujaku.
The Great Red Dragon is a guardian of the Valley and the overaching protagonist of the original series. He acts as Fone Bone's personal guardian and the leader of the Dragons.

Doozies are giant blueberry shaped creatures. In "The Lollistops," Chowder and Gazpacho were almost close in to stealing teeth in the Toothporium until a Doozie was guarding it. Voiced by Carlos Alazraqui.
A bracer was a piece of armor that protected the wrist and forearm. Bracers most often came in pairs, and magical ones usually only imparted their power when both were worn.
is a half-giant bard from the Shattered Teeth. He is played by Tom Cardy. Ethel is also the physical embodiment of the island of Evaterena.
Fomorian giants, or fomorians, are a race of giantkin deformed by a fey curse that they can spread to others with a glance.
Gloomstalkers are flying monstrosities native to the Shadowfell.
The Bow of Eletha was an enchanted bow once carried by the elf warrior Eletha.
is a reiloran juggernaut working for the Volition in the city of Kreviris on Ruidus. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.
Giant oxen are huge beasts of burden with fey ancestry trained by giants.
A giant octopus is a large beast found in waters across Exandria.
Breastplates of silent moves were sets of magically enchanted and well-oiled medium armor that allowed the wearer to move silently without suffering the negative effects of wearing bulky armor.
is the High King of frost giants of the Neverfields in northern Tal'Dorei. He has not appeared in Critical Role.
is a halfling firetamer of the Fire Ashari. As an NPC in Exandria Unlimited Prime, is played by Aabria Iyengar.
is a half-orc Archivist of the Cobalt Soul in charge of the teleportation circles of the order in Rexxentrum. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.
The Bowl of Loneliness was a great dune field located in the Sword region of the Anauroch desert.
The Mossback Steward is an ancient, intelligent horizonback tortoise with magical abilites that dwells within Brokenveil Marsh.
, sometimes misleadingly called ogre mages, are a type of giantkin with magical abilities.

Red dragons are, even for dragons, extraordinarily arrogant and covetous. They favor high perches like mountains or even hills, and they prefer areas of volcanic or geothermal activity. They are tyrants who command armies of lizardfolk, kobolds, and the like, and consider every other creature their rightful cattle or slaves.
A breastplate of Hidden Imaskar was a set of enchanted armor of Imaskari design.
A phoenix is an enormous bird of elemental fire famous for its ability to be reborn.
Potentate Sammanar, They-Who-Walk-Unseen, is an Archfey of the Feywild, Keeper of the Sun's Shadow, and Master of the Unseelie Court.
Salamanders are lizard-like elementals native to the Elemental Plane of Fire.
Bottled lightning was a weapon attachment, a cartridge that held one powerful charge of mundane or magic lightning.
(pronounced SEE-vah) is a powerful druid of the Circle of Ancients, the matriarch of the Lloy family, and Thaisha's direct ancestor. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Siff Duthar was a necromancer who lived during the Age of Arcanum. He experimented with binding undead souls to the physical remains of bodies, eventually performing the process on himself when he became an allip.
Silvercomb is a harpy grandmother of the Ashwing tribe and captain of a commandeered pirate ship.
Branwyn Vaupel was a member of the Crimmor Guard during the mid-to-late 14 century DR. She was the youngest amongst her peers to attain the title of High Sword, the four commanders of the guard.
Simurghs are massive creatures with hawk-like bodies and heads like canines. They are native to the Oderan Wilds of Marquet and are sometimes used as mounts in Jrusar.

Silver dragons are sociable true dragons who dwell in cold environments, whether mountaintops, caverns, or preferably abandoned humanoid structures, but often spend much of their time traveling as humanoids.
Skiraths are monstrosities that hunt the skies of the Hellcatch Valley in Marquet.
The Bow of Hosark was a powerful magical longbow associated with unicorns and possibly with the faiths of Mielikki the Forest Queen or Lurue the Unicorn.

Symphior was a planetar who was planted to grow and eventually protect the land. However, its development was interrupted by the corruption of the land, which made it deformed. It was awakened early by the Myriad's drilling for platinum, and started terrorizing the mines.

Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon is the deity of good-aligned dragons and metallic dragons, being considered the first of their kind. He is a sworn enemy of Tiamat, the Scaled Tyrant, who is the queen of the chromatic dragons.
Tempus was the griffon mount of Zerxus Ilerez, the First Knight of Avalir. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.
Breaths of the Maiden were mysterious enchanted shortswords found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.
is a male goliath and bodyguard to Celia Ovesso. Although he was described, he never spoke.
Toxoshuul is a young green dragon from the Ashen Gorge, in Tal'Dorei.

Whaska is a fire giant who is the forgemaster of the Zenith Forge in the City of Brass. He is one of the three fire giants who are not enslaved in the City of Brass. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.
The Botany Bay was a ship that sailed the waters of Maer Dualdon sometime before the early 14 century DR.

was a half-elven mage and a member of the Cerberus Assembly, filling the role of Archmage of Antiquity. As an NPC, was played by Matthew Mercer. In The Mighty Nein, Vess DeRogna is voiced by T'Nia Miller.
is a morkoth who lived on the island of Rumblecusp, believed to be a great fire god by the island's residents. As an NPC, Vokodo is played by Matthew Mercer.

White dragons are the smallest, least intelligent, and most animalistic of the chromatic dragons. White dragons dwell in frigid climes, favoring arctic areas or icy mountains. They are reported to inhabit the island of Beissel in Eiselcross.
Borlyth Bay was a small bay south of the Cloakwood on the Sword Coast North.
Zariel is a fallen angel and one of the archdevils of the Nine Hells as the Archduchess of Avernus.
is a tortle, pierced by multiple hooks and spikes, and a mortal avatar of Torog, the Crawling King. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Rhonda Pineda was an advance agent coming to Earth 0 before the Trinity War and Forever Evil events, posing as a heroine and preparing for the arrival of the rest of the team with the help of the Outsider. Her false identity was Atom. She was in a relationship with teammate and partner in crime Johnny Quick. Rhonda Pineda was created by Geoff Johns and Jesús Saíz, first appearing in (2012). | Gallery = File:Crime Syndicate Future State Earth 3 0001.jpg|
Borlyth was once a fishing hamlet on Cloak Bay of the Sword Coast North that turned into a monster-infested ruin.
Bane is one of Batman's greatest enemies, being best known as "the man who broke the bat."

{{Disambig | Image = Action Comics Vol 1 1061 Textless Andrews Variant.jpg | ImageText = Bizarro | MainPage = Bizarro-Superman (Earth 29) | Era1 = Infinite Frontier | Description = Bizarro No. 1 is the first and most prominent of the Bizarros. The original Bizarro Superman created by the Duplicator Ray, he is a bizarre and imperfect duplicate of Superman. He married Bizarro Lois Lane and had a son named Bizarro Junior. His entire world of Htrae is populated by imperfect duplicates, so he has taken to wearing a stone slab with #1 around his neck. Bizarro has been reinvented several times, and several of them also called themselves number one; even versions that don't include the Duplicator Ray. Bizarro No. 1 was created by Otto Binder and George Papp, first appearing in (1958). | Gallery = File:Bizarro Silver Age 01.jpg| File:Bizarro 0001.jpg|

{{Disambig | Image = Komand'r Prime Earth 001.png | MainPage = Komand'r (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Komand'r | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = | Description = Blackfire is a Tamaranean super-villain and enemy to the Teen Titans. Born to the royal family of Tamaran, her brother is Darkfire and her sister is Starfire. Despite being the eldest child, her subjects hated her and the birthright was passed to Starfire because of this. This made her hate her sister, and she was disgraced from the family after trying to murder her. Joining the Citadel empire, she betrayed her people and helped the invaders subjugate them. Blackfire was created by Marv Wolfman and George Perez, first appearing in (1982). | Gallery = File:Blackfire 001.jpg| File:Starfire Vol 2 1 Textless.jpg| File:Ryand'r Prime Earth 001.jpg| File:Joseph Blackfire Prime Earth 001.jpg|
The Bow of Arvoreen was an enchanted red shortbow wielded by an aspiring halfling paladin, Mazzy Fentan, in the late 14 century DR.

Brakkal was a follower of Maglubiyet who lived on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.

{{Disambig | Image = Justice League of America's Vibe Vol 1 1 Textless.jpg | ImageText = Vibe | MainPage = Francisco Ramon (Prime Earth) | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = Paco Ramone; Cisco Ramon | Description = Cisco Ramon was a civilian who was caught in the event horizon of a Boom Tube during Darkseid's first invasion of Earth, and was exposed to interdimensional forces who rewrote his DNA and transformed him into a metahuman with vibrational powers. He helped A.R.G.U.S. find and restrain dangerous fugitives from other realities, becoming the second-youngest member of the Justice League of America known as the hero Vibe. He is also the brother of Dante and Armando Ramon. Beginning his career as an inventor at Alva Technologies, he swore to take down his corrupt mentor Edwin Alva after learning that Alva was part of the criminal organization S.Y.S.T.E.M.. Ironically, he set out to take his boss down from inside Alva's basement using corporate resources. He has been a member of Hard Co. and the Shadow Cabinet. Bow of awareness was an enchanted halfling short bow designed to be wielded by the small folk as a longbow.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Ibac the First (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Ibac the First | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = | Description = Ibac is a super-villain granted incredible powers by Lucifer, he fights against Captain Marvel as a champion of evil. In his civilian identity he is incompetent small-time crook Stanley "Stinky" Printwhistle. His powers include terror from Ivan the Terrible, cunning from Cesare Borgia, fierceness from Attila the Hun and cruelty from Caligula. He has been a member of the Monster Society of Evil and the Secret Society of Super-Villains. Ibac first appeared in (1942). | Gallery = File:Ibac 01.jpg| File:Ibac 004.jpg| File:Ibac_II_Prime_Earth_0001.JPG|

{{Disambig | Image = Major Victory I 01.jpg | ImageText = Bill Vickers | MainPage = William Vickers (New Earth) | Era1 = Iron Age | AltID = | Description = Major Victory is William Vickers, a patriotic superhero with a suit that gives him special powers. His career began as the leader of Force of July, a group sponsored by racist government officials. He has also been a member of the Captains of Industry, the Shadow Fighters, and the Suicide Squad. Eventually he died in battle against Eclipso. His successor Major Victory II was captured by the Hollow Men. Major Victory III is the leader of Freedom's Ring, a group within the organization S.H.A.D.E.. Major Force rips off his arm and beats him to death with it. He is replaced by Major Victory IV. Major Victory was created by Mike W. Barr and Jerome Moore, first appearing in (1984). | Gallery = File:William Vickers Prime Earth 0001.jpg|

{{Disambig | Image = Batman The Brave and the Bold Vol 2 18 Textless Variant.jpg | MainPage = M'gann M'orzz (Prime Earth) | ImageText = M'gann M'orzz | Era1 = New 52 | Description = Miss Martian is the younger female counterpart to Martian Manhunter, a superhero active as a member of the Teen Titans. She is a member of the malevolent White Martians race unlike her Green Martian predecessor, although she works hard to prove herself and discredit the stereotype. In her civilian identity, she is high-school student Megan Morse. Miss Martian was created by Geoff Johns and Tony S. Daniel, first appearing in (2006). | Gallery = File:TanamiDesert1.jpg|

A bow and arrow set was a type of toy designed for children to play pretend and emulate rangers, as well as means by which to teach children proper etiquette regarding ranged weaponry. Despite being supposedly harmless fun, it was generally advised that adults supervise children playing with them.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Henry Hall (New Earth) | Era1 = Iron Age | AltID = | ImageText = Hank Hall | Description = Monarch is a super-villain identity originally used by Hank Hall, also known as Hawk of Hawk and Dove. Hall took this identity to become the totalitarian dictator of Earth in the post-apocalyptic Armageddon 2001 future, where his partner Dove had died. This future was prevented by Matthew Ryder, but Hall still went insane and became Monarch earlier while the world's heroes could still stop him. His signature weaponry is a suit of power armor that magnifies his own abilities. Eventually Hall would abandon this identity to become Extant during Zero Hour. Captain Atom became Monarch when he was forced to wear the armor as a containment suit, and turned insane as well. During the events of Countdown, Atom used these powers to travel the Multiverse assembling an army to fight the Monitors. Eventually the armor was destroyed by Superboy-Prime and Atom returned to sanity as an amnesiac. Monarch was created by Archie Goodwin, Dennis O'Neil and Dan Jurgens, first appearing in . (1991) | Gallery = File:None.jpg| File:Captain Atom Prime Earth 0025.png| File:Countdown 44cov.jpg| File:MonarchEJ7.jpg|

{{Disambig | Align = | Image = Justice League Dark Vol 1 32 Textless.jpg | ImageText = Nightmare Nurse | MainPage = Asa (Prime Earth) | Era1 = New 52 | Description = The Nightmare Nurse is a demonic healer named Asa, who eventually became a ally of both Justice League Dark and the Suicide Squad. She was originally the housekeeper of Alice Winter in the House of Mystery, but she decided it would be better if she possessed the younger woman's body as her current host was old and decrepit and Alice was very sick. Asa is also a very powerful magic user. Nightmate Nurse was created by Dan DiDio, J.M. DeMatteis and Philip Tan, first appearing in (2013). | Gallery = File:Asa Futures End 001.jpg|

{{Disambig | Image = File:Plastique PE 01.jpg | MainPage = Bette Sans Souci (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Bette Sans Souci | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = Bette Sans Souci | Description = Plastique is Bette Sans Souci, an explosive super-villain, originally seen as an enemy to Firestorm. Beginning her career as a terrorist, she eventually reformed and became a mercenary. The President pardoned her for helping the government, and she became married to Captain Atom. Following their divorce, she returned to a life of crime. She has been a member of the Bomb Squad, Extreme Justice, the Secret Society of Super-Villains, and the Suicide Squad. Plastique was created by Gerry Conway and Pat Broderick, first appearing in . (1982) | Gallery = File:Plastique (by Javier Pina) 1.jpg|
Brannox was a weapon merchant from Luskan during the late 15 century DR.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Iolande (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Iolande | Era1 = New 52 | Description = Princess Iolande is an alien super-hero known as Green Lantern and a member of the Green Lantern Corps. The Guardians of the Universe gave her a power ring fueled by willpower to protect Space Sector 1417. Her home planet is Betrassus where she is a member of the royal family. She succeeded Myrrt and her original partner was Soranik Natu of Korugar. Princess Iolande was created by Dave Gibbons and Patrick Gleason, first appearing in . (2006) | Gallery = File:Iolande.jpg| File:Iolande GL Legacy 001.png|

{{Disambig | Image = Lazarus Planet Dark Fate Vol 1 1 Textless Burnham Variant.jpg | MainPage = Clifford Steele (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Cliff Steele | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = Robert Crane; Clifford Steele | Description = Robotman is a robotic superhero with a human brain. In his civilian identity he was race-car driver Cliff Steele until an accident destroyed his body. His brain was only saved by the intervention of Niles Caulder, who transplanted it into a cold unfeeling robot body. He is a founding member of the Doom Patrol. In the Golden Age, the first character to use the name was Robert Crane as a member of the All-Star Squadron. Robotman was created in his Robert Crane incarnation by Jerry Siegel and Leo Nowak, first appearing in . (1942) Cliff Steele was created by Arnold Drake, Bob Haney and Bruno Premiani, first appearing in . (1963) | Gallery = File:Cliff Steele 001.jpg| File:Robotman_crane.jpg| File:Automan Prime Earth 001.png| File:Fake Robotman 01.JPG|

{{Disambig | Image = Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps Vol 1 14 Textless.jpg | ImageText = Bro'Dee Walker | MainPage = Bro'Dee Walker (Prime Earth) | Era1 = New 52 | AltID = Blue Lantern | Description = Bro'Dee Walker, also known as Saint Walker, is the leader of the Blue Lantern Corps and the first ever Blue Lantern. He hails from Astonia in Sector 1. In order to become a Blue Lantern, one must be willing to give of themselves completely to the universe. Saint Walker is able to inspire hope in others and will hope until the day he dies. Saint Walker was created by Geoff Johns and Ethan Van Sciver, first appearing in . (2008) | Gallery = File:Saint Walker 002.jpg|
The bow of the Silver Flame was a holy longbow found in Eberron during the mid-1480s DR of Faerûn.

{{Disambig | Image = Selinda Flinders (Prime Earth) 0001.jpg | ImageText = Selinda Flinders | MainPage = Selinda Flinders (Prime Earth) | Era1 = New 52 | Description = Shimmer is an Australian supervillain with elemental transmutation powers named Selinda Flinders. Alongside her brother Mammoth, she is a member of the Fearsome Five and an enemy to the Teen Titans. She has also been a member of the Secret Society of Super-Villains and the Suicide Squad. Shimmer was created by Marv Wolfman and George Pérez and first appeared in (1981). | Gallery = File:Shimmer 001.jpg|

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Rikane Starr (Prime Earth) | ImageText = Ric Starr | Era1 = New 52 | Description = Space Ranger, Guardian of the Solar System, is a space-traveling adventurer and super-hero in the 22nd Century. He is an expert pilot, marksman, scientist and detective with an arsenal of futuristic gadgets and weaponry. Working as an executive at his father Thaddeus Starr's company Allied Solar Enterprises, he lives a double-life protecting Earth from invaders and other threats using his ship the Solar King. His secret identity is only known to shape-shifting alien sidekick Cryll and his girlfriend Myra Mason. Space Ranger was created by Edmond Hamilton, Gardner Fox and Bob Brown, first appearing in . (1958) | Gallery = File:Space Ranger 001.png| File:J'onn J'onzz Space Ranger 001.png| File:Justice League Odyssey Vol 1 16 Textless.jpg| file:Space Ranger Batallion 001.png|

{{Disambig | Image = Terra-Man 002.jpg | MainPage = Tobias Manning (New Earth) | Era1 = Iron | AltID = | ImageText = Tobias Manning | Description = Terra-Man is Tobias Manning, a super-villain and an enemy of Superman. His signature style is using futuristic technology in the style of the American Old West. Originally he was shown to be a 19th Century orphan abducted by an alien, who trained him to be an interstellar outlaw. In Post-Crisis continuity, he was a businessman turned eco-terrorist. He has been a member of the Secret Society of Super-Villains. Eventually he was killed by Black Adam during 52. In the DC Rebirth continuity, Manning is similar to his Pre-Crisis counterpart. Terra-Man was created by Cary Bates, Curt Swan, and Dick Dillin, first appearing in (1972). | Gallery = File:Tobias Manning Earth-One 0001.jpg| File:Tobias Manning Prime Earth 0001.jpg|
Lord Breiyr was a frontier noble of the Sword Coast North in the 3 century DR. He was the Lord of Morlin Castle.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Rex Stewart (DCAU) | AltID = | Era1 = DC Animated Universe | ImageText = Rex Stewart | Description = Warhawk is Rex Stewart, a superhero in the Batman Beyond future. Introduced in the DCAU, Rex works with Terry McGinnis, the new Batman, as a member of Justice League Unlimited, making him their counterpart to Hawkman. It is later revealed that he is the future son of the Green Lantern John Stewart and Hawkgirl. Warhawk was created by Paul Dini, Alan Burnett and Bruce Timm, first appearing in the Batman Beyond episode The Call (2000). | Gallery =
Exos are a species of humanoid machines, both for players and non-player characters, in Destiny and Destiny 2.
Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer was a Psion and one of Emperor Calus' Shadows.

Breathtakers and their more powerful variants, exalted Breathtakers, were a variety of artifact created to be used by fighter adventurers in the Chultan city of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15 century DR.

The Hive, originally known as Krill are an impossibly ancient race that battled humanity at the end of their Golden Age. They most prominently reside on the Moon, where they have burrowed deep within its lifeless core, carving out a kingdom for themselves. They have been silent and buried among many dark and terrible secrets, staying there for centuries while growing stronger. They serve as a reminder of the tremendous power that brought forth the Collapse.
Keksis, the Betrayed is a Taken Captain encountered in the Prison of Elders.

The Primeval Mind is a member of the Sol Progeny that guards the Black Heart in the Black Garden. It is the last Vex Minotaur you face in the Story Mission. Its appearance is different from the Sol Progeny and is similar to the Vex who make up the Precursors. It wields a Torch Hammer like the others, but this one fires blasts similar to a Cyclops's attack. It represents the past and the beginning of time. He is the Axis Mind of the Vex programming, Sol Primeval.

Breathstoppers and their more powerful variants, exalted Breathstoppers, were a variety of artifact shields created to be used by fighter adventurers in the Chultan city of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15 century DR.

Savathûn, formerly known as Sathona, is a Hive God and sister to Xivu Arath and Oryx, the Taken King. She and her sisters were the last brood of the Osmium King. Together with her two siblings, she was a progenitor of the contemporary Hive species and one of its chief gods, having made a pact with the Worms of Fundament. She is driven to become the mightiest warrior in the universe.
Silimar was a Titan, one of the Iron Lords, and architect of the Iron Temple atop Felwinter Peak. He was always looking for ways to offer better protection.

Stormjoys were non-sapient predatory creatures native to the gas giant Fundament. Described as "living clouds," they would drift over land masses and dangle tentacles tipped with "bait stars" to attract and catch prey. In the Osmium Court, they were known as a good way for an old person to choose death. A daring knight could also cut off the bait stars from the tentacles. Xi Ro bragged that she had six.
Brella Ilfrost was a fighter adventurer who served Baron Uldonner Erendrin as one of the twelve Baron's Blades in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Syrok, Word of Oryx is a taken Knight Ultra encountered in The Coming War.

Tormentors are a a form of Dread that serve as heavy units and carry their scythes which uses Void attacks. They are able to suppress targets and perform their Dark Harvest move to grab their target. They can only be damaged in their shoulders initially before they change their weak spots to be in its chest. They are identified by the hulking frame and a singular yellow eye on their face.

Aksis, Archon Prime was the leader of the Devil Splicers and the latest claimant to the title of Archon of the House of Devils when the SIVA Crisis occurred. The Devil Splicers worshiped him as a god. He serves as the main antagonist of the expansion Rise of Iron and the final boss of the Wrath of the Machine raid.
Bream ball was a quality bait used in ice-fishing in the village of Twilight Tor on the Sword Coast North.

Amsot is a Psion scribe and royal historian who serves Emperor Calus. They were responsible for conducting and transcribing the experiments that went aboard the Glykon with the Scorn and Crown of Sorrow. They would survive the experiments up to the events of Calus communing with the Lunar Pyramid in which they sent out a message to the rest of the Cabal Empire to join their Emperor in his ascension.

Agon, Strategic Hydra is a Vex Hydra of the Sol Collective. It attempted to invade the CloudArk by passing through the broadband connections of the Thrilladrome, but was found and stopped by The Guardian. Agon is an extremely aggressive Hydra that will bombard the player with shots from its Aeon Maul. It will only spawn once the Cyclops in the room has been defeated.

Ahztja is a Psion in the service of the Cabal Empire. At the time of Calus's reign, she was the Emperor's Mythkeeper, praised for the vastity of her knowledge. She would often narrate myths of other worlds to an infant Caiatl as bedtime stories, such as the Tiiarn tale of how the universe came to be. She would also tell Caiatl tales of the events surrounding the Guardians' hunt on the Ahamkara to extinction, known as the Great Ahamkara Hunt.
Breath weapon substitution was a spell used by dragons that allowed them to change the energy or element of their breath.
Achar, Undying Wizard is a Lightbearer Wizard striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.
Bakris, the Adamantine is a Fallen commander from the House of Salvation found within the Cosmodrome.

Aye-I, Privateer was an extremely powerful Fallen Heavy Shank and the leader of a crew of pirates hired by Eramis, the Shipstealer, to assist her in hunting for the lost relics of Nezarec on behalf of the Witness. It served as one of the final bosses of the now-unavailable Ketchcrash activity.
Breath weapon admixture was a spell used by dragons that allowed them to add an extra energy or element to their breath.

Au'gor, Devoted of Calus is a powerful Cabal Colossus and a champion of Emperor Calus's Loyalists. They are encountered alongside Jai'ek, Supplicant of Calus, in the Royal Pools of the Derelict Leviathan when the Imperial boarding party is in the area.
Antioptes, Hypogean Sentinel is a massive Vex Cyclops that is encountered at the end of Battleground: Core.

Banuk, Ur Prince was a powerful Hive Knight and a member of the Swarm Princes: a group of legendary Knights who served the god Crota, Son of Oryx. Banuk was encountered at the Hellmouth on the Moon as part of the The Sword of Crota Mission, where he was slain by the Guardian in their quest to destroy the Sword of Crota.

Branislav Semyon served as a bodyguard within the Tower of the Blades in Mulmaster and often carried out assassin work for High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin. He often disguised himself as Draazu, one of the region's earliest hired killers. Branislav was not the only person to have taken this name, only furthering the legend and mystery surrounding Draazu's whereabouts.

Brakion, Genesis Mind is a Vex Hobgoblin that served as the Vex Mind of the Pyramidion on Io and the main boss of the aforementioned Strike in Destiny 2. It later appears as the final boss of //NODE.OVRD.AVALON//, now named Variant Stalker Brakion, Repurposed Mind, having been repurposed as a specialized unit to hunt down Asher Mir's influence in the Nexus.
Barrier Colossi are powerful Cabal Champions armed with personal Barrier shield abilities they use to protect themselves when threatened.

Bracus Gaa'ron, Coalition Ally is a Cabal Incendior and a Bracus of the Imperial Cabal. They are one the three members of Caiatl's boarding party that can be called to Royal Pools of the Derelict Leviathan.
Bren Tallsword was a male human fighter and the commander of the forces stationed at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the mid–14th century DR.

Bracus Gu'ulan, Shamed Legionary is a powerful Cabal Colossus at the rank of Bracus that was introduced during the Festival of the Lost Event in 2022. They were encountered in the Haunted Sector based in the Flooded Chasm on Earth.
Blighted Gravekeepers are gigantic Hive Ogres encountered in the defense of the Temple of the Navigator.

Citan was a brutal Titan Warlord who ruled the 32nd Sector of Old Russia during the Dark Age. His territory's western border was marked by Citan's Ridge, with the land of his fellow Warlord Felwinter beyond it.
The Bright Blade Brandished was a favorite tavern of adventurers in Silverymoon.
Choros, the Dampening Mind is one of three powerful Vex Minotaurs maintaining the dampening field to prevent the Kepler singularity from growing.
Coda, the Dampening Mind is one of three powerful Vex Minotaurs maintaining the dampening field to prevent the Kepler singularity from growing.

The Disciple of Harrow is a Cabal Colossus of the Barant Imperium and disciple of Dredgen Harrow, encountered during the Fire and Ice Exotic Mission, impeding the Guardian from collecting their own Praxic Blade.
Bron was a human fighter and paladin of Eldath and the Lord of Iriaebor in the mid–14 century DR.
The Dread Assassin is a powerful Tormentor and one of the possible final bosses of Solo Ops: Typhon Imperator.

Empathic Sentinel is a powerful Storm Minotaur that appears in the "O Captain" World Quest on Nessus. New types of the Empathic Sentinel have appeared in Goblin and Hydra form although not much else is known weather or not they serve some purpose or if they are just a common enemy. No other versions of Vex "sentinels" have been found

Drusk, the Crushing Fist was a unique Centurion that appeared as the main boss of the A Frame Job Adventure. As the name suggests, they were responsible for quelling enemy forces that oppose the will of the Red Legion.
A broadsword, or a broad sword, was a medium-sized sword used for slashing.

Eksori was a Fallen Captain of the House of Devils who sought to gain glory and respect by killing the famous Guardian, Rezyl Azzir, in an ambush and claim him as a trophy. However, Azzir quickly cut down his crew and beat the Captain to death with his bare hands.

Ei Arat, Trespasser was a Hive Lightbearer Wizard who commanded a portion of the Lucent Brood's forces in their search for a relic of Nezarec. They led an assault on the asteroid 43193 Secinaro — the hideout of Vrisk, the Coward — where one of the artifacts was hidden. The Wizard appeared in the Pirate Hideout: The Coward activity as the final boss.
Elikaa, the Pale Rot is a powerful Scorn champion of Fikrul, the Fanatic that was sent to make a wish with one of Riven's Whims.
Buiyrandyn () was a tiny drow settlement in the northern Underdark, beneath the northern Sword Mountains, north of Southkrypt and west of Wyvern Tor
Elite Compelled Harpies are a common variant of Elite Harpy in the Nessian Schism.
Garaask, Unyielding Inferno is a Cabal Shadow Legion Incendior. They are a champion under Emperor Calus's ranks and was sent to challenge The Guardian and to stop them from reaching the Radial Mast.
Golakh, Befouler is a powerful Hive Ogre of Xivu Arath's Horde that assaulted Savathûn's Spire at the lead of a horde of Wrathborn's assault.
A buckler, also known as a target shield, was a small shield useful as a defense in melee combat. Due to its small size, a buckler was of limited use in defending against missiles.
Gorkall, the Gatekeeper is a Taken Ogre in the European Dead Zone tasked with protecting the anchor that the Dire Taken intended to utilize to pull the Ascendant Plane into Earth.
Hiraks, the Mindbender is a Hive-obsessed Baron of the Scorn and an Ascendant Eliksni.

Hallowed Ogres are the common Major variant of the Hive Ogre in Destiny, found across the broods of the Sol System. While they share no differences in appearance towards their minor counterparts, they can be distinguished by their increased health, strength, and yellow health bars. In Destiny 2, Hallowed Ogres appear as common Elite variants of the Taken Ogre. They can be encountered in several occasions, be it patrolling the Dreaming City or protecting Savathun's Marionettes on Io.

Brin might refer to one of the following: * Aubrin Crownsilver, a human male follower of Torm. * Brindani, a half-elf fighter. * Brindlor Zidorion, a male drow deathsinger. * Brindor Olóssyne, a half-elf King of Aglarond. * Brin a halfling pirate.

The High Ogre of Xivu Arath is a powerful and decorated Hive Ogre who was sent by Xivu Arath, God of War to assault the ritual to remove Savathûn's Worm in the Exorcism Mission. It is encountered at the entrance to the Ritual Spire, where it attempts to overpower the defenders and breach the door, but it is killed by the Guardians.
Gwern, the Unbeatable was a powerful warrior that was slain by Voyc, Shadow of the Wilds using the Leviathan's Breath.
Honorchasing Colossi are an Ultra Red Legion variant of the Colossus. They can be seen deployed to a Proving Grounds all across Sol and act as hardened reinforcements for the front line.
Bruneil was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North.

Ir Garza, Scourge of Earth is a powerful Wrathborn Wizard in the service of Xivu Arath. They would assist Eramis, Kell of Darkness and the Fallen House of Salvation with reclaiming the Seraph Station in order to activate the Warsat network and target the Traveler on Earth.

Ioneion, System Control Flow, is a Vex Mind of the Sol Collective, with the form of a giant Minotaur. It is encountered in the Vex Network, where it administers a series of stress tests for various Vex operations. The Guardian, directed by Osiris, would take part in one of these tests, seeking to master the power of Strand, and slay the Mind along with all its troops.

The Inevitable Mind is an Vex Mind and one of the units collectively known as the Temporal Progeny that serve as the vessels to the newly created Black Heart. Its appearance is that of a Descendant Minotaur.
Breyarg Stonebreaker was a paladin of Gorm Gulthyn in the service of Helm and a member of the Fellowship of the Purple Staff.
Horiil, Flame of Night is a Taken Incendior striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.

Illiiks is a Dreg of the House of Exile on Kepler. He was hesitant to use Dark matter, but after being called out by Levaszk, he accepted it, leading him to convulse as his body changed with the intake of the Dark Matter.
The Imperium War Beast is the common Minor variant of the War Beast in the Barant Imperium.

Brittleskin was a spell that caused the natural armor of a creature to become hard and brittle. If that creature were struck in combat, the crystallized tissue (such as hide, bone, chitin, scales, etc) would crack and shatter, causing more permanent and often lethal damage.
Kashur, the Infinite Blaze was a Cabal Legionary that was encountered in the Injection Rig Public Event during the EDZ Flashpoint.

Kakos, Herald of the Plague is a giant Taken Minotaur seen in the Blind Well. It is a subordinate of Inomina, Plague of the Well, and can be seen with Oxus, Herald of the Plague and Kydoimos, Herald of the Plague.

Kerrev, the Erased is a powerful Dread Weaver. After the fall of the Witness, ey sought to free the forces of the Dread from the voices that sought to command them by rallying the Hive within the Sunken Pyramid to take control over it. Ey serves as the final boss of the Sundered Doctrine Dungeon.
Buckley's buckler was a target shield that was made of mammoth hide.
Kaag, Bone Breaker is a Hive Ogre of Xivu Arath's Horde striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.

Khoros, Harmony Monitor is a powerful Harpy of the Nessian Schism encountered on Kepler. It can rarely appear while exploring Vex-heavy areas, whereupon their appearance will be signaled by a message on screen. Defeating Khoros awards the player with the Quantum Substance it transports.

Korosek, Thronebringer is a Hive Lightbearer Wizard Commander who attempted to pull Savathûn's Throne World into the material plane from the Scarlet Keep for a Lucent invasion of Earth. They are encountered as the final boss of the PsiOps Battleground: Moon activity.
Broadhand's Forge and Tack was a weapons and armor shop located to the south west of Silverymoon. It secretly housed an altar room in dedication to Bane.

The Leviathan-Eater, Bane of the Ammonites (formerly known as Ir Uulxal) is a Knight and the most powerful champion of the Hive God Xivu Arath in her brood. Known for killing the Leviathan that once graced the Ammonites, he would later be tasked with stealing the tithes to Eris Morn and to kill the Guardian in the process.

The Locus of Wailing Grief is a Taken Ogre and second boss of the Warlord's Ruin Dungeon. Following the Witness's travel into the Pale Heart and excommunication of Xivu Arath from her Throne World, the Locus and its Taken would become aimless without a leader. They would eventually come under the command of the Ahamkara Hefnd due to his strong willpower.
Mahesh, the Bitter is a powerful Taken Centurion sent to claim a fragment of the Traveler during the mission Off-World Recovery.

Brielbara was a human wizard living in Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast in the mid–14 century DR. She was one of the most notable mages in the city circa 1358 DR. She was known for developing many new spells.
Malignant Harpies are a Major variant of the Vex Harpy. They look like normal Major Harpies and boast high durability and aggression. They were first encountered during Season of the Seraph.

Minotaur Accompli is a powerful Vex Minotaur of the Sol Collective. It is encountered on Neptune, where it attempts to take over the CloudArk by hijacking the operations of the Shadow Legion. It appears in the third step of the first stage of Terminal Overload, attempting to disperse the Guardians with hordes of its brethren. On top of the usual giant Minotaur abilities, it can fire a blinding Arc Slap Grenade. It has no invulnerability phases and can be swiftly slain by a group of players.

Minotaur Harpax is a powerful Vex Minotaur of the Sol Collective. It is encountered on Neptune, where it attempts to take over the CloudArk by hijacking the operations of the Shadow Legion. It appears in the third step of the second stage of Terminal Overload, attempting to disperse the Guardians with hordes of its brethren. On top of the usual giant Minotaur abilities, it can fire a blinding Arc Slap Grenade. It has no invulnerability phases and can be swiftly slain by a group of players.

Briel's School of the Arcane was a school of wizardry in Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast. It was founded by the Archmage Briel, who'd written a letter to the city stating his plan to start a school of wizardry there; this was preserved in the city's archive. However, this was done at the guidance of the lich Aumvor the Undying, as part of his plan to revive Netheril's spirit of spellcasting, arcane research, and experimentation in Netherese bloodlines, after previous efforts in the Brotherhood of the Black Hand in Ascalhorn and Ulcaster's School of Conjuration in Beregost failed spectacularly. The result was Briel's School of the Arcane, but it too ultimately failed some time before 1374 DR.

The Modular Upsilon is a massive Taken Minotaur appearing as the final boss of the mission Fury in Destiny 2. It is accompanied by a Modular Sigma, a Taken Goblin which protects it by projecting an impenetrable shield.

Mirmo is a powerful Dire Knight that was split into three different expressions and scattered across the Cosmodrome. It would be hunted down by the Guardian to claim the shard of Willbreaker they possessed.
Overload Captains are powerful Fallen Champions graced with heightened ability regeneration.
Brughor Axe-Biter was the leader of a group of scouts from the Many-Arrows tribe in the late 15 century DR.

Optus Taxaat is a Cabal Psion of the Imperial Cabal who serves as an Optus and is one of the Imperial Generals who volunteered to defend the champion of Cabal, Ignovun, Chosen of Caiatl. They are slain by a group of Guardians inside the Halphas Electus during the Proving Grounds Strike.
Optus Siluu, Coalition Ally is a Cabal Psion and a Optus of the Imperial Cabal. They are one the three members of Caiatl's boarding party that can be called to Royal Pools of the Derelict Leviathan.
Once-Iriis, Failed Variable is powerful Scorn that was imprisoned by the Lucent Brood within Savathûn's Spire to be experimented upon.
The Broken Crown Inn was an inn found on the High Road north of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.
Phogoth, the Untamed was a massive Hive Ogre imprisoned within the Summoning Pits deep within the Hellmouth on the Moon, held in its chamber by great chains.

Persys, Primordial Ruin is a Vex Wyvern of the Sol Divisive encountered as the final boss of the Spire of the Watcher Dungeon. It is one of the two Sol Divisive minds sent by The Witness to infiltrate the Ares Spire and send it into overload after stealing its data.
Prill, Undying Knight is a Lightbearer Knight striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.
Brigandine was a type of composite light armor, a cross between studded leather and splint mail armors.

Quria, Blade Transform, also known as the Dreaming Mind, was a Vex Mind Hydra that was Taken by Oryx in the ancient past. Created by the Vex to conquer Oryx's Throne World and unravel its secrets by gaining an understanding of the Sword Logic, Quria was defeated and Taken by Oryx, but was allowed a measure of free will. The Taken King later gifted the Mind to his sister, Savathûn. Following Oryx's death, Quria was utilized by Savathûn to command the remaining Taken and create new ones, with Quria having acquired the ability to Take via paracausally-enhanced simulations of Oryx. Later, Quria played an integral role as the architect of the Endless Night, and served as the season antagonist for Season of the Splicer. It was ultimately defeated by the Guardians with the assistance of Mithrax.

Psion Commanders are Psionically adept field commanders seen coordinating the Red Legion in the fractured timelines created by The Sundial. Seen in the Datamine and Psion Flayer encounters, they were usually seen defending key assets such as Vex Sync Plates chocked full of data and the Psion Flayer Sisters. They later returned to shield high-value targets in the Exotic mission, Vox Obscura.

Ransaaks, Privateer was an extremely powerful Fallen Captain and the leader of a large crew of pirates, consisting of both Eliksni and Cabal. They were hired by Eramis, the Shipstealer, to assist her in hunting for the lost relics of Nezarec on behalf of the Witness. They served as one of the final bosses of the now-unavailable Ketchcrash activity.
Bub Snikt was a lone hunter from Beregost on the Sword Coast, active in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Raphrax, Keeper of the Rift is a Taken Knight summoned forth by the Resonant Knife within the Hall of Souls to prevent the Guardian from cutting a rift into Eris Morn's Throne World; the High Heresy.

Reaktos, Possessive Wyvern was a powerful Compelled Wyvern of the Nessian Schism. It could be found in the Well of Flame by the Guardian and destroyed as they were searching for Radiolite and other samples of Nessus' transformation by the Echo of Command.

Revered Colossi are a Major variant of the Colossus. Like other Major Colossi, they don golden armor with red highlights, and boast high durability and aggressiveness. They can be seen deployed to Proving Grounds all across Sol and act as hardened reinforcements, leaders, and honor guards for the front line.
The Bright Shield Inn was an inn located in Suldolphor in far eastern Calimshan in the late 14 century DR.

Sardok, Eye of Oryx is a giant Hive Knight who protects the Shrine of Oryx. As soon as the Guardian breaches the shrine, Sardok is immediately called upon to protect it and draw the Guardian out, but they are eventually defeated, and the shrine is destroyed.

Sumok, Ravager of Torobatl is a large Wrathborn Ogre. They were tasked by Xivu Arath, God of War to conquer and take control of the Seraph Facility, which they protected against Imperial Cabal attacks. When The Guardian was sent to infiltrate the structure, the Ogre confronted them with its troops, and was slain in battle.
The Drowned is a powerful Nightmare Chieftain found on the Derelict Leviathan.
Bright shields were enchanted heavy shield created to be used by dungeon-delving adventurers some time before the late 14 century DR.

Thumos, the Unbroken is a unique Centurion that features as the main boss of the story mission Unbroken. He is one of Dominus Ghaul's most trusted lieutenants, or as Zavala said one of Ghaul's "Chosen". He was responsible for the death of many of Suraya Hawthorne's people while operating on Earth, until his death at the hands of the Guardians. It is heavily inferred he is the commander of the Blood Guard, Ghaul's own personal guard.

Time Warden Borduros is a Cabal Centurion seen as the second boss of the Gatecrash encounter in The Sundial, where the Time Warden attempts to stop the Guardian Fireteam from sabotaging their energy network.

Time Warden Calid'Valof is a Cabal Centurion seen as the second boss of the Datamine encounter in The Sundial, where the Time Warden attempts to stop the Guardian Fireteam from sabotaging their data collection operation.
Bronor was a malaugrym impersonating a merchant in the Sword Coast North during the mid–14 century DR.

Time Warden Legatul is a Cabal Blood Guard Incendior seen as the first boss of the Bombardment encounter in The Sundial, where the Time Warden attempts to stop the Guardian Fireteam with their new tech and weaponry, as well as the weaponized light of the Traveler.

Thur'Ak was a Gladiator of the Cabal Empire who participated in the Fall of Torobatl. Cabal soldiers rumored that he broke the charge of the Hive alone at Tor'trol, standing against a horde of Thrall one hundred strong.

Thysaeuc, Quicksilver Psion is an Imperial Cabal Psion sent by Empress Caiatl alongside Decima, Shielding Psion and Nuajes, Hacking Psion to assist the Guardian in breaching Bunker WAR-6 to stop Maya Sundaresh from using a Warsat to expand the influence of her Echo of Command.
Briney Valesaris was a half-elf buccaneer who captained the ship known as the Cambacks.
Tomoc, Psion Flayer is one of the three Psions who sought to evolve into Flayers through Rasputin during the Psionic Potential Adventure.

Trammels of Time are Major Taken Ogres encountered in Salvation's Edge alongside the Trammels of Conflict and Demise in defense of the Herald of Finality, using their power and presence to prevent the intruding fireteam from wielding the energies of the Monolith.

Torrix, Hunter of Power is a powerful Dread Attendant found aboard the Dreadnaught hunting for the source of immense Taken power tied to Xir-Kuur. Killing them grants the player a Taken Osseous Fragment, that can be used to unlock the Derealize Exotic Mission.
Brewbanks family shield was a unique enchanted shield wielded by Wilfred Brewbanks in the late 15 century DR.
Tresk, Undying Trooper is a Lightbearer Acolyte striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.
Uplifted Choral Harpies are a variant of Harpy within the Nessian Schism.

Valus Ta'aurc was the Fleet Commander of the Siege Dancers, although he remained a member of the Dust Giants. From his Imperial Land Tank, the Cerberus Vae III, Ta'aurc was infamous for conquering more land than any other commander in the Cabal Exclusion Zone on Mars, which encompasses the entire city of Freehold in their territory.
Brensyl the Tall was a hero of legend in the ancient history of Abeir-Toril. Brensyl was reputed to have wielded Namarra, the Sword That Never Sleeps.
